entities.name: Erwin Lichnofsky
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Erwin Wilhelm Maria Lichnofsky, sometimes referred to as Johann Lichnovsky or Johann Lichnowski, was a Czech ice hockey player. He competed for Czechoslovakia in the men's tournament at the 1928 Winter Olympics.
